cards.text: Friend, the Gospel of Matthew opens with the record of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham. My family tree? One bin at a bakery that was closing down, and a price sticker that said 25 cents.

Then comes the list, father to son: Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, down to David the king, down through the exile to Babylon, all the way to Joseph, the husband of Mary. A few moms make the list too, like Tamar, Rahab and Ruth. It adds up to three stretches of fourteen generations, and here I am losing count of the cookies on ONE tray.

Now here's how the birth of Jesus Christ came about: His mother Mary is pledged in marriage to Joseph, but they haven't come together yet. That's the engaged stage, where the biggest problem is SUPPOSED to be the seating chart.

cards.question: Before Mary and Joseph come together, Mary is found to be with child. Through whom?

cards.text: Joseph, her husband, is a righteous man, and he's unwilling to disgrace Mary publicly. Friend, I spent years wedged between dead batteries in a junk drawer, and even I wouldn't trade places with Joseph right now.

cards.question: Joseph is righteous and unwilling to disgrace Mary publicly. So he resolves to ___ her quietly.

cards.text: But after Joseph ponders these things, an angel of the Lord appears to him. Friend, when I'M stuck pondering something, the only one who shows up is my oven timer!

cards.question: After Joseph ponders all this, the angel of the Lord appears to him. Where does it happen?
Joseph has resolved to divorce Mary quietly. The angel tells him to go ahead with it.

cards.text: Mary will give birth to a Son, the angel says, and Joseph is to give Him the name Jesus. No baby name book, no family group chat vote, the name comes SPECIAL DELIVERY!

cards.question: The angel says Joseph is to name Mary's Son Jesus. Why?

answers.text: He will save His people from their sins
He will rebuild the temple in Jerusalem
He will lead His people home from exile

cards.text: Then the Gospel of Matthew tells us all this took place to fulfill what the Lord had said through the prophet Isaiah (Isaiah 7:14). Lean in, friend, because these words are a BIG deal.

cards.question: The prophet's words say the ___ will be with child and give birth to a son.
The prophet says they will call the Son Immanuel. What does the name Immanuel mean?
When Joseph wakes up, what does he do?

answers.text: Tells the priests what he saw

cards.text: Joseph has no union with Mary until she gives birth to a Son. And he gives Him the name Jesus, but friend, this story is only getting started.
